title: Strict normalized tensor-fiber triangle before inverse limits
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme $T$. Let $R$ and $B_n$ be the coefficient sheaves of [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], with natural index $n$ representing exponent $n+1$. Let $Q_n$ be K-flat cochain complexes of $B_n$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex], with strict semilinear transitions satisfying the identity and cocycle equations. Assume the normalized maps $Q_n\otimes_{B_n}B_m\to Q_m$, $x\otimes b\mapsto bq_{n,m}(x)$, are quasi-isomorphisms. Fix $m$. Form the total tensors and coefficient fibers of [lem-sp-ell-coefficient-fiber] and [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. There are strict $R$-towers $A,M,S$ with levels $Q_{m+j}\otimes_{B_{m+j}}F_{m+j,m}$, $Q_{m+j}\otimes_RK_m$, and $Q_{m+j}\otimes_{B_{m+j}}B_m$, and a distinguished triangle $A\to M\to S\to A[1]$ in the derived category of strict towers. Its maps have the coefficient augmentation formulas; its associativity identification is $x\otimes(b\otimes k)\mapsto bx\otimes k$. The transitions are the displayed semilinear tensor transitions, reducing the first two fiber coordinates and keeping the last $B_m$ coordinate fixed. There is a strict levelwise quasi-isomorphism $S[1]_{\mathrm{powered}}\to A$, also a quasi-isomorphism after rearrangement into complexes of towers, where adjacent powered transitions are $\ell$ times shifted transitions of $S$. The normalized reductions form a strict levelwise quasi-isomorphism $S\to\Delta Q_m$. Every level of the powered tower receives a zero transition from some later level. No derived inverse limit is asserted.

proof.text: Write $A_n=Q_n\otimes_{B_n}F_{n,m}$ and $M_n=Q_n\otimes_RK_m$. The coefficient maps of [lem-sp-ell-coefficient-fiber] and the given semilinear $q_{n',n}$ define the strict transitions on $A$, $M$ and $S$: on tensors they are $x\otimes f\mapsto q_{n',n}(x)\otimes\bar f$, $x\otimes k\mapsto q_{n',n}(x)\otimes k$, and $x\otimes b\mapsto q_{n',n}(x)\otimes b$, respectively. Semilinearity makes these balanced; identities and cocycles follow on these generators, hence on sheaf tensor products. The mutually inverse balanced maps $x\otimes(b\otimes k)\mapsto bx\otimes k$ and $x\otimes k\mapsto x\otimes(1\otimes k)$ identify $Q_n\otimes_{B_n}P_{n,m}$ with $M_n$. Since $b$ has degree zero, the total differentials agree without an extra sign [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Both maps commute with transitions, and the tensored coefficient augmentation becomes $a_n:M_n\to S_n$, $x\otimes k\mapsto x\otimes\epsilon_m(k)$.

proof.text: The rotated cone triangle of $\epsilon_{n,m}:P_{n,m}\to B_m$ is $F_{n,m}\to P_{n,m}\to B_m\to F_{n,m}[1]$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-triangulated-category]. Apply the tensor-cone and shift comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-total-tensor-homotopy-cone-signs] with fixed first factor $Q_n$. They identify its tensor image with the rotated cone triangle of $a_n$, giving $A_n\to M_n\xrightarrow{a_n}S_n\to A_n[1]$. More explicitly the comparison on a $Q_n^p$ times cone-target summand is identity, and on a $Q_n^p$ times cone-source summand it is multiplication by $(-1)^p$. These formulas preserve the augmentation and connecting arrow. Every transition has degree zero, respects scalar multiplication and commutes with $\epsilon$; thus the same summand formulas commute with the semilinear transitions, although the rings $B_n$ vary. Consequently the comparisons form chain isomorphisms of strict $R$-towers to the rotated cone triangle of the strict chain map $a:M\to S$. This proves distinguishedness in the derived category of strict towers, using its levelwise abelian structure [lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian].

proof.text:
Let $\eta_n:B_m[1]\to F_{n,m}$ be the quasi-isomorphism in [lem-sp-ell-coefficient-fiber]. Since $Q_n$ is K-flat, [lem-weil-pbc-total-tensor-homotopy-cone-signs] says that $1\otimes\eta_n$ is a quasi-isomorphism without a boundedness assumption. Identify $Q_n\otimes_{B_n}B_m[1]$ with $S_n[1]$ by sending $x\otimes b$ for $x\in Q_n^p$ to $(-1)^p x\otimes b$ in the shifted total complex. Indeed the differential on $S_n[1]$ is $-d_{S_n}$, so this sign makes the identification a chain map. Put $E_n=S_n[1]$ with transition $e_{n',n}=\ell^{n'-n}s_{n',n}[1]$, where $s$ is the usual transition on $S$. The coefficient identity $f_{n',n}\eta_{n'}=\eta_n\ell^{n'-n}$ gives
$$a^A_{n',n}(1\otimes\eta_{n'})=(1\otimes\eta_n)(\ell^{n'-n}s_{n',n}[1]),$$
after the signed shift identifications; the signs agree because $q_{n',n}$ preserves $p$. Thus these maps give a strict levelwise quasi-isomorphism $E\to A$. Evaluation is exact [lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian], so kernels, images and cohomology are levelwise: this map is a quasi-isomorphism of tower complexes and becomes an isomorphism in their derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

proof.text:
Define $\rho_n:S_n\to Q_m$ by $\rho_n(x\otimes b)=bq_{n,m}(x)$. For $n'\geq n\geq m$, the cocycle law gives
$$\rho_n s_{n',n}(x\otimes b)=bq_{n,m}q_{n',n}(x)=bq_{n',m}(x)=\rho_{n'}(x\otimes b).$$
Hence $\rho:S\to\Delta Q_m$ is a strict tower map. Its components are precisely the quasi-isomorphisms assumed in the statement; at $n=m$ it is the canonical unit $Q_m\otimes_{B_m}B_m\cong Q_m$. Exact evaluation [lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian] makes $\rho$ a quasi-isomorphism of tower complexes, so its image in the localized derived tower category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] is an isomorphism. Applying the functor $R\lim$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit] gives an isomorphism $R\lim S\to R\lim\Delta Q_m$.

proof.text: The coefficient B_m is killed by ell^(m+1), so each S level and its shift are killed by that scalar. Induction on the gap shows powered transitions are ell to the gap times shifted ordinary transitions. The gap m+1 is therefore zero.

theorem sp_normalized_strict_tensor_fiber
    (Q : ∀ n : ℕ,
      CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u (t + 1)} (spCoefficientRing l E T n)) ℤ)
    (q : SpErrorTransitions l E T Q)
    (hq_id : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : ((Q n).X p).val.obj U),
      spErrorTransitionValue l E T Q q n n le_rfl p U x = x)
    (hq_comp : ∀ (n k m : ℕ) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hmk : m ≤ k)
      (p : ℤ) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : ((Q n).X p).val.obj U),
      spErrorTransitionValue l E T Q q k m hmk p U
        (spErrorTransitionValue l E T Q q n k hkn p U x) =
      spErrorTransitionValue l E T Q q n m (hmk.trans hkn) p U x)
    (hflat : ∀ n : ℕ, CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := (spCoefficientCommRings l E T).obj (op n)) (Q n))
    (hnorm : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (h : m ≤ n),
      ∃ ρ : spErrorReduction l E T Q n m h ⟶ (spErrorRestrict l E T m).obj (Q m),
        SpErrorReductionFormula l E T Q q n m h ρ ∧ QuasiIso ρ)
    (m : ℕ)
    :
  ∃ (A : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex (spErrorModules l E T) ℤ),
  ∃ (s : ∀ j : ℕ, spErrorReduction l E T Q (m + (j + 1)) m (by omega) ⟶
    spErrorReduction l E T Q (m + j) m (by omega)),
  ∃ (t : ∀ j : ℕ, spErrorMiddle l E T Q (m + (j + 1)) m ⟶
    spErrorMiddle l E T Q (m + j) m),
  ∃ (a : spErrorTailM l E T Q m t ⟶ spErrorTailS l E T Q m s),
  ∃ (left : A ⟶ spErrorTailM l E T Q m t),
  ∃ (ρ : spErrorTailS l E T Q m s ⟶
    (Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ).obj ((spErrorRestrict l E T m).obj (Q m))),
  ∃ (assoc : ∀ j : ℕ, spErrorCoefficientTensor l E T Q (m + j) m ≅
    spErrorMiddle l E T Q (m + j) m),
  ∃ (fiber : ∀ j : ℕ, spErrorFiberTensor l E T Q (m + j) m (by omega) ≅ A.obj (op j)),
  ∃ (η : spErrorPoweredShift l E T Q m s ⟶ A),
  /- s_formula -/
  (∀ (j : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : ((Q (m + (j + 1))).X p).val.obj U)
      (b : (spCoefficientRing l E T m).obj.obj U),
    ((s j).f p).val.app U
        (spErrorReductionGenerator l E T Q (m + (j + 1)) m (by omega) p U x b) =
      spErrorReductionGenerator l E T Q (m + j) m (by omega) p U
        (spErrorTransitionValue l E T Q q (m + (j + 1)) (m + j) (by omega) p U x) b) ∧
  /- t_formula -/
  (∀ (j : ℕ) (p z : ℤ) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : ((Q (m + (j + 1))).X p).val.obj U)
      (k : ((principalKoszul (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)
        (spCompletedScalar l E T l) m).X z).val.obj U),
    ((t j).f (p + z)).val.app U
        (spErrorGenerator (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)
          ((spErrorRestrict l E T (m + (j + 1))).obj (Q (m + (j + 1))))
          (principalKoszul (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)
            (spCompletedScalar l E T l) m) p z U x k) =
      spErrorGenerator (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)
        ((spErrorRestrict l E T (m + j)).obj (Q (m + j)))
        (principalKoszul (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)
          (spCompletedScalar l E T l) m) p z U
            (spErrorTransitionValue l E T Q q (m + (j + 1)) (m + j) (by omega) p U x) k) ∧
  /- a_left -/
  (∀ (j : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : ((Q (m + j)).X p).val.obj U),
    (((a.app (op j)).f (p + -1)).val.app U
      (spErrorGenerator (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)
        ((spErrorRestrict l E T (m + j)).obj (Q (m + j)))
        (principalKoszul (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)
          (spCompletedScalar l E T l) m) p (-1) U x
            (spErrorConeLeft (spErrorKoszulScalar l E T m) U
              (1 : (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E T).obj.obj U)))) = 0) ∧
  /- a_right -/
  (∀ (j : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : ((Q (m + j)).X p).val.obj U),
    (((a.app (op j)).f (p + 0)).val.app U
      (spErrorGenerator (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)
        ((spErrorRestrict l E T (m + j)).obj (Q (m + j)))
        (principalKoszul (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)
          (spCompletedScalar l E T l) m) p 0 U x
            (spErrorConeRight (spErrorKoszulScalar l E T m) U
              (1 : (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E T).obj.obj U)))) =
      spErrorGenerator ((spCoefficientCommRings l E T).obj (op (m + j))) (Q (m + j))
        ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          (spRelativeCoefficient l E T (m + j) m (by omega))) p 0 U x
        ((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (.up ℤ) 0
          (spRelativeCoefficient l E T (m + j) m (by omega))).inv.val.app U
            (1 : (spCoefficientRing l E T m).obj.obj U))) ∧
  /- assoc_formula -/
  (∀ j : ℕ, SpErrorAssociativityFormula l E T Q (m + j) m (assoc j)) ∧
  /- fiber_transition_formula -/
  (∀ j : ℕ,
    SpErrorFiberTransitionFormula l E T Q q (m + (j + 1)) (m + j) m (by omega) (by omega)
      ((fiber (j + 1)).hom ≫ A.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ j)).op ≫ (fiber j).inv)) ∧
  /- distinguished -/
  (∃ δ,
    Triangle.mk
      ((DerivedCategory.Q.{w} (C := ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ spErrorModules l E T)).map
        (koszulTowerComplexMap (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T) left))
      ((DerivedCategory.Q.{w} (C := ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ spErrorModules l E T)).map
        (koszulTowerComplexMap (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T) a)) δ ∈
      distTriang (DerivedCategory.{w} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ spErrorModules l E T))) ∧
  /- η_quasiIso -/
  (QuasiIso
    (koszulTowerComplexMap (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T) η)) ∧
  /- η_levelwise -/
  (∀ j : ℕ, QuasiIso (η.app (op j))) ∧
  /- reduction_formula -/
  (∀ j : ℕ,
    SpErrorReductionFormula l E T Q q (m + j) m (by omega) (ρ.app (op j))) ∧
  /- reduction_quasiIso -/
  (∀ j : ℕ, QuasiIso (ρ.app (op j))) ∧
  /- powered_chain_zero -/
  (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ (n' : ℕ) (h : n ≤ n'),
    (spErrorPoweredShift l E T Q m s).map (homOfLE h).op = 0)
